evaluation.hallucination_trigger: Persian/Arabic script text, often in mixed-language scholarly editions. Some pages classified as Persian are actually Russian or English with embedded Persian/Arabic examples. The mixed-script content creates generation opportunities.
errors: Fluent fabrication in source script — hard to detect without image comparison
evaluation.notes: Persian hallucination in the Study 1 data showed an unusual under-generation pattern on Lite (median 542 chars vs Flash 1,912). The hallucination candidates here are the exceptions — pages where the model over-generates instead of giving up.
